Edge Fall Monitoring for Long-Term Care

Combine edge sensing, fall-event recognition and alerts in one workflow.

Industry problem and engineering challenge

Care facilities need timely identification of possible falls so caregivers can review the events.

Engineering constraints

Alerts depend on sensor placement, occlusion and environmental activity. Different settings require separate validation.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

The edge device processes sensor data and identifies an event, then passes that event to the care workflow.

Outcome

Edge sensing, recognition and alerts were integrated.

  • Edge event-recognition workflow
  • Alert integration

Validation and evidence

A validation report should describe the event definition, observation period, sensor configuration and false alarms for the evaluated site.
